name: Ensure Compact Therapeutic Nutrition (4 fl oz)
whyItWorks: Condenses 220 calories and 9g protein into just 4 fluid ounces (half the normal volume). Ideal for patients who experience rapid fullness, nausea, or abdominal distention when consuming standard 8 oz liquid cans.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill and drink in just a few sips with meals or medications.
